label_product: TYLENOL Extra Strength (Kenvue Brands LLC), 500 mg tablets
label_quote: adults and children 12 years and over take 2 tablets every 6 hours while symptoms last do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor
note: OTC label. Maximum is 6 tablets x 500 mg = 3000 mg in 24 hours for this product. The same label's liver warning cites 4,000 mg in 24 hours as the damage threshold, so the 2x level (6000 mg) is above both figures.
